title: .tick/runners.cloud.toml still routes every cloud role to kind "pi"
description:
The cloud overlay applies last, so the FINAL resolved runner of every cloud role of this repository is "pi" from the overlay's cells — not the profile set's new pi-durable. The profile flip alone does not change what a cloud dispatch binds (TICKS_HARNESS): routing_check_test still pins the final cloud runner as "pi" and passes. Once jhp's image is deployed (image/common.sh's kind set becomes omp | claude | pi-durable), a cloud run of this repository starts — CloudRule still admits "pi" — and every worker container dies at boot with "unknown harness kind 'pi'": A1's cloud end state and A4's real cloud run both break. The overlay is outside an implement-tick's permitted .tick writes (config.md, runners.toml, learnings.md only), so it is reported here rather than changed. Only the cloud overlay's cells need the flip: the common runners.toml's kind = "pi" is the local substrates' correct name for the same durable harness (tick hpk) and must stay.
evidence: .tick/runners.cloud.toml [roles.implement], [roles.review], [roles.review.tiers.strong], [roles.closeout] — kind = "pi" in each; the check still passes with final runner "pi" at internal/reconcile/routing_check_test.go:60; jhp commit 6b6a71f6 (image/common.sh kind set omp|claude|pi-durable, "a profile or deployment naming pi is refused by the container at boot, loudly")
